safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

The powder is smooth, adheres evenly and gives true color payoff from the very first swipe, with a comfortable feel in use.

howToUse.text: Use a fingertip or makeup brush to pick up an appropriate amount of powder, apply to the eye area and blend gently to create the desired color effect.

shadeDescription.text: Fresh apple palette with bright pink, apple red, warm brown and champagne pink.

benefits.text:
The 6-pan BBIA Ready To Wear Eye Palette is a daily eye palette of easy-to-use shades that can be combined flexibly, from base and shading shades to accent shades. The palette is designed to create two makeup moods: fresh and light like Green Apple, and radiant like Red Apple, suited to everyday use while still offering enough of an accent for an S/S layout. The soft powder texture adheres smoothly and helps minimize fallout, so color goes on naturally and is easy to blend and combine. The shades in the palette balance a light base, fresh pink, accent red, shading brown, champagne pink highlight and medium-deep brown, helping complete eye makeup from soft to more striking.

Apple Edition is an S/S collection inspired by the juicy freshness of apples. In the Ready To Wear Eye Palette, the Apple Edition spirit comes through an eye palette that is both fresh and lovely, helping complete the Green Apple Makeup Look and the Red Apple Makeup Look in a single palette.

howToUse.text: Apply the base shade over the whole lid, the shading shade to create depth and the accent shade to emphasize the outer corner or lower lash line. The highlight shade can be used on the under-eye area, inner corners or center of the lid to add brightness.

positioning.text: Daily apple-inspired eye palette with base, shading, accent and highlight shades to complete both the Green Apple Look and the Red Apple Look.

sellingPoints.text: 6 apple-inspired shades; combinable from base to shading to accent; soft texture that adheres smoothly and helps minimize fallout.

texture.text: Soft, smooth eyeshadow, easy to blend, low fallout.

finish.text: Soft matte / shimmer highlight / balanced eye finish.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say the eye color is absolutely long-lasting or 100% fallout-free. Do not use treatment/irritation claims without test details.
